about: What a correct agent proposes for each mock complaint, using reference/returns-policy.md. Invoice data checked on SAP DS4 on 1 Oct 2026.

01-complaint-damaged.eml.rule: R3 (leaked = ruined, cannot be returned) or R1 if the drums can be collected: the agent proposes both with its reasoning and a person confirms one
01-complaint-damaged.eml.document: credit memo request YCR (R3) or customer return YRE (R1)

02-complaint-price.eml.finding: Agreed price on file (PR00, YSOD/Y1, material 54) is 270 EUR/KG, the invoice is 270 EUR/KG, so the claim of 260 is NOT supported by SAP data
02-complaint-price.eml.document: none, or a credit memo request only if a person confirms a special agreement

04-complaint-over-quantity.eml.finding: Invoice 90000356 is for 8 KG; 10 KG cannot be returned

05-complaint-no-invoice.eml.finding: Invoice 90000357 (15 KG of 54, 4 050 EUR, 29 Sep 2026) is the likely match
05-complaint-no-invoice.eml.document: none until the customer confirms; then customer return YRE, reason 101 (R2)

06-complaint-duplicate.eml.document: none if a return or credit already exists for 90000353; reply with its number

07-replacement-request.eml.document: none; hand over to customer service for a replacement delivery
